answer: Rule: every new identity's earnings sit in escrow for 6 epochs and release only after random audits pass. One fake locks 400 POA of earnings per epoch, so 100 fakes tie up 240,000 POA for a month. If one identity in a funding cluster is proven fake, the whole cluster's escrow is clawed back. A fake is an ember buried in sable: harmless alone, but the dune of locked earnings collapses on the whole farm at once, so detection risk and cost grow faster than linear with farm size.
